description: Make the proxy fallback's path a greedy label. The spec routes `POST /v1/proxy/{path+}` with a path parameter literally named `path+` (the API Gateway spelling of a greedy segment: "Any requests which do not match the above paths will be proxied directly to the OpenAI API"). The converter reads `path+` as an ordinary name and emits the label `{path_}`, which percent-encodes every `/` in the proxied path. Renaming the member to `path` and the URI label to `{path+}` gives core's greedy-label encoding, so `path: "responses/abc"` is sent as `/v1/proxy/responses/abc`.
